content.text: to make the soul to come again
all the desirable of the eye
And he hath violently taken away
shall I take to witness for thee?
to thee, that I may comfort thee,
make to return to my heart
unto them that wait for him,
of those that rose up against me,
For the punishment of the iniquity
Than the punishment of the sin
in that they could not but touch
carry thee captive for thy sins
on our necks are we persecuted
the crown of our head is fallen [† symbol is missing in 1611 text]
for wilt thou utterly reject us?
